title: What to Do After You Break a Rule

launchpad.outcome: Review a violation into an IF / THEN response you can use when the trigger returns.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What will I do when this trigger appears again?

slides.title: She chased.
scenario: She missed the previous winner (no retest).

options: No market entry after a missed retest
action.correct: No market entry after a missed retest

slides.thenPrefill: screenshot it, mark it MISSED ACCORDING TO PLAN, and wait for a new valid setup
slides.punch: Saved: the next time a missed winner shows up, your answer is already written.

slides.title: Two ways to finish a review
slides.verdict: Discipline isn’t a mood. It’s a pre-written response.

slides.fallbackLine: A missed winner often creates an urge to chase the next one.
slides.punch: This is what the Academy will show you whenever this trigger comes back.

slides.quote: A violation is data about a trigger. Turn it into a plan.

slides.prompt: What is your response after a rule violation?
slides.modelAnswer: I review it: which rule, what happened right before, what I was trying to get or avoid, what the rule-based action was, and IF this trigger happens again THEN what I’ll do.

takeaways: Your saved response comes back when the trigger does.
remember: JOURNAL WHAT YOU’LL DO WHEN THE TRIGGER RETURNS.
